name: Newsmax

What Newsmax says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenueThe Company is maintaining its underlying full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $212 million to $216 million, which excludes the $14.0 million one-time revenue item recognized in the third quarter and represents 13% year-over-year growth at the midpoint of the range. Including the one-time revenue item, the Company’s full-year 2026 revenue guidance is $226 million to $230 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 12, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
